notes: Saved 2026-11-14 (Hong Kong) through createFetcher (fixture request 7 of 8, .superpowers/raw-pages/charming/ledger-fixtures.tsv), trimmed with the allow list in docs/operators/charming.md.
One tour code (PCCGG), one variant, twelve dates, all status HP (plain): none full, so all twelve are kept.

Each price is the adult (sharing a room) price after the early-booking discount (.detail-discount-price, 3398), not the price before it (.detail-original-price, 5398): it is the price the page shows as current. The page says offers are limited; the card's 'check with the operator' covers that.
fromPriceHkd is null: the page's only 'from' figure is in a script (min_original_price, before the discount); normaliseTour takes the lowest date price.

Day 1 `香港 ~ 無錫/南京/上海 ~ 南京 ~ …` loses the flight leg `無錫/南京/上海` (either city, next to Hong Kong), and the last day `烏鎮（…） ~ 杭州/上海機場 ~ 香港` loses `杭州/上海機場`, as Jetour's and EGL's parsers do. Every other heading is as the page gives it, whitespace collapsed.
The day-4 label is `Day ４` with a full-width digit; it counts as a day.
startPoint and endPoint are the first place of day 1 and the last place of the last day (`香港`), the page's only statement of where the tour starts; both normalise to Hong Kong.
The title is kept as the page gives it, with its ` ~ PCCGG`.
Stops and unmatched names are as they come out with places/data.json as it stood on 2026-11-14; the unmatched names are sights, not places.
